en.intro1Vo: The last safe zone is under attack! The zombies are getting closer!
en.intro2Vo: These walls can stop the zombies, but only the right circle pieces can pass through!
en.intro3Vo: Match the correct circle parts, stop the zombies, and protect the safe zone!
en.qShape: Which piece will pass through the wall?
en.qNameSub: No labels this time — pick the right shape.
en.qIdentifySub: Choose the correct mathematical name for the opening.
en.fbLostHeart: You lost a heart. Look at the opening again.
en.hintGenericArc: Look carefully. The opening is a thin curved strip along the edge — an arc is a curve, not a filled region.
en.hintGenericSector: Look carefully. A sector has two straight radii meeting at the centre and a curved arc.
en.hintGenericSegment: Look carefully. A segment has one straight chord and a curved arc — it never touches the centre.
en.hintArcSector: You chose an arc — only the curved edge. The opening is a filled wedge with two radii: a sector.
en.hintArcSegment: You chose an arc — only the curved edge. The opening is a filled cap cut by a chord: a segment.
en.hintSectorArc: You chose a sector — a filled wedge. The opening is only the thin curved edge: an arc.
en.hintSectorSegment: You chose a sector, whose straight edges are radii meeting at the centre. The opening has one chord: a segment.
en.hintSegmentArc: You chose a segment — a filled cap. The opening is only the thin curved edge: an arc.
en.hintSegmentSector: You chose a segment, bounded by a chord. The opening reaches the centre with two radii: a sector.
en.hintChordAny: A chord is just a straight line. The opening is a region bounded by that chord and an arc: a segment.
en.hintSizeMinor: Right shape, wrong size! The opening is smaller than half the circle — that makes it MINOR.
en.hintSizeMajor: Right shape, wrong size! The opening is bigger than half the circle — that makes it MAJOR.
en.endSub: You matched the circle parts and protected the safe zone!
en.goSub: Don't worry — let's look at the piece together.
en.goWatch: Watch the correct piece complete the circle:
en.rotateDevice: Please rotate your device to landscape ↻
